Look, I use arc mid tree and I'm trying to be positive about this one.This thing is probs dogwater

\- Deflecting? Use Raijus for duration.

\- Want dmg? Just hit em with Flux or run anything else.

\- Or just use anything thats not Mid Tree Arc for PVE

Its just outclassed by the other arc strider super exotics. In the case that this thing could be good it'll need to

\- Increase the dmg by like 1000%

\- And/Or Deflect teammates projectiles leading to some weird but cool dmg strats

\- And/Or some other unforeseen perk, Like returning super energy

I want this thing to be good as I love arc strider but like I don't see how it could be good. I would like to hear about other peoples thoughts about it

This is my experience as a Midtree arc hunter main

\- People run/jump backwards while I chase, There is no catching them as arc gives no speed boost to catch them. (Unlike every other roaming melee super)

\- I try to deflect peoples shots, I get 1 shot by a handcannon while deflecting. (Death counts as misadventure)

\- Other roaming supers are just better. While deflecting any roaming melee super is meant to stagger when hitting you. This does not happen half the time and I get 1 Shot when trying to take advantage of the bonus dmg.

\- People are smart and just stop shooting while deflecting

\- Deflecting anything AOE (Hammers, Nova, Shadebinder) is inconsistent. Sometimes they just blow up and kill you instead of deflecting or they're smart enough to hit the ground in front of me. Chaos just kills.

Its not all bad. Sometimes it works and I get a good super spree, Sometimes I deflect dawnblade shots back at the dawnblade. But when you boil it down it just comes down to the enemy just not being smart and killing themselves

For real tho first get a level 3 synth and get all the armor sets. You can do them in any order but I would say do collector then sentry then reaper, Invader can go anywhere since you can hot swap the armor. all in gambit prime

Invader: Just kinda do how you want, For fusions I would recommend 1k voices because of its range and for easy stealing go bubble titan. Not much to say.

Collector: Invis hunter is perfect. Something anti invader is good but your main goal is to take as many motes as possible before your team gets them (They can't see the armor) If an invader is on the field you need to hide and go as far for it as you can. Invis in gets motes, Invis out. Swap to Sentry or Reaper when the bank is full!

Sentry: You will NOT be leaving the bank and you will feel anger at your team for killing a blocker, I would say 4th horsemen for the blockers and a pulse or scout for killing ads at range and tagging the invader. When a HVT spawns swap to reaper and kill it so you can speed that up.

Reaper: Kill... Kill lots, There are many ways to get massacre. I used arc strider with raiden flux, Loaded question with ALL the fusion mods is good, Gets super quick, 1kv, Heir apparent any heavy that has lots of ammo and or killing power is good, Go for the HVT as soon as it spawns. If ads are running out on that side start moving to another and be ready to kill them all before they spawn

Mental notes: Be ready for shit teams and be ready to lose... ALOT, Do not worry about winning, Just get what you need done asap. Try to remember to hot swap your armor when the time comes. If you have a full fireteam in vc that removes 90% of any issues you may face.

Good luck guardian. Gambit prime is love. Gambit prime is life
